payload.detail: tests/cli/build.test.ts:152-156 (CON-005 test) collects import specifiers from dist with the regex /(?:from|import)\s*["']([^"']+)["']/g over all emitted JS. That regex also matches string literals, not only imports. dist/parse/index.js contains the array literal ["--category", "--from", "--to"] (and ["--from", "--to"]), where the text from", " is captured as the specifier ", " which starts with neither . nor node:, so the test fails. The record CON-005 says the shipped product has no third-party runtime dependencies; the product has none (package.json dependencies empty, every real import is relative or node:). The literals live in src/parse/index.ts (T-003 write-set, outside this task's writes), and they are the spec-mandated option names --from/--to, so the code cannot legitimately change. All other 158 tests pass, tsc --noEmit exits 0.
